data.taskBrief:
TASK BRIEF: Geocode a street address into latitude and longitude using the EdgeConnect SD-WAN Orchestrator API (HPE Aruba Networking)

FIT
Fully. The supplied request directly geocodes an address and returns matching locations with latitude and longitude. No supplied requests are irrelevant.

AUTH
API key authentication via the `X-Auth-Token` header: `X-Auth-Token: <apiKey>`. The collection references `{{apiKey}}`, but no value for that variable is supplied; provide the API key created in Orchestrator.

BASE URL
https://172.16.3.20/gms/rest

STEPS
1. GET /location/addressToLocation
   Params:
     address: string — for example `1600 Amphitheatre Parkway, Mountain View, CA`; send it as the required query parameter `?address=...`.
     Accept: string — `*/*`; send it as a request header.
   Returns:
     200 OK. A JSON array of matching location objects, ordered from best to worst match. Each object may include `formatted_address` (string), `address_components` (array), `geometry.location.lat` and `geometry.location.lng` (numbers), `geometry.bounds`, `geometry.location_type`, `geometry.viewport`, `place_id` (string), and `types` (array). Use the first array element for the best match.
   Threading:
     None

GOTCHAS
- URL-encode the `address` query value; do not put it in the request body.
- The response is an array, so select the first matching object when the best match is required.
- Read coordinates from `geometry.location.lat` and `geometry.location.lng`.
- Supply a real `apiKey` as `X-Auth-Token`; the provided collection does not define its value.
- The collection base URL is `https://172.16.3.20/gms/rest`; replace it only if the caller's Orchestrator instance uses a different base URL.
